passkeys.sectionDescription: Use one instead of a verification code when signing in to the operations console. An account can register several, so switching devices does not mean unbinding first.
passkeys.emptyDescription: Add one and you can sign in to the operations console with a fingerprint, your face, or a security key.
passkeys.consequenceLast: This is the last passkey on the account. Once it is gone you will not be able to sign in with a fingerprint, your face, or a security key. If this account is required to use passkeys, the server will refuse this deletion.
passkeys.consequenceOther: The key stops working immediately and can no longer be used to sign in; the other passkeys on the account are unaffected. A deleted key cannot be recovered — you would have to register a new one.
